short_description: A Phase III diabetic-kidney-disease trial is 44% behind its enrollment plan. The Trial Site Copilot (Databricks App on Lakebase) uses AI Functions to read the screening-log notes the sites coded as OTHER and finds that one exclusion criterion written before SGLT2 inhibitors became standard of care causes 39% of screen failures. The Genie agent, reading the protocol, SAP and SOP, confirms that the criterion can be amended and that the safety criterion must stay. A UC-registered site-enrollment model ranks rescue sites, a deterministic projection moves last-patient-in forward 15 months, and the study manager approves the rescue plan with a write-back to Lakebase. A portfolio AI/BI dashboard and Genie work on the same gold tables.
